I can answer this in general terms, but the right pick depends on your schedule and goals, so let me pull your training and profile first. Nothing is logged yet, so I don't have your history, schedule or goals to lean on. Here is the general picture.

Upper/lower hits each muscle group about twice a week, with a day on each side of the body's big lifts, and it suits people who can train 4 days. PPL works well at 3 to 6 days, but each muscle usually gets hit once a week unless you run it twice through, which means more days in the gym.

If you can train 4 days and want to press and squat more often, go upper/lower. If you have 3 days or want a simple split with a clear focus each session, go PPL.

Tell me how many days a week you can train and what you want most, a bigger bench, bigger legs, or just to look better, and I'll say which one I'd pick. If you want it built, I can set that up with the Build it button.
